reason: I would rather ask the friends who already did their cars than buy from an app with a handful of partners just added in Riyadh and Cairo. The ID and registration checks help, but they do not tell me how the work will look on my M4.
objection: I have never used these partners and nobody I know has, so I would be paying a stranger through an app to touch a car I just paid a lot for.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or someone I trust has used a partner through ArmorHub and shows me the finished work on their car.
